en: Vintage multi-view sepia postcard with four scenes labeled in German: a large baroque manor or small palace labeled 'Schloss', a church with adjacent school building labeled 'Kirche u. Schule', a village street scene labeled 'Dorfstrasse', and a brickworks yard or simple industrial building labeled 'Ziegelei'. At the bottom center it reads 'Gruss aus Martinskirchen.' The left edge has a vertical publisher imprint mentioning 'Verlag von F. Eliette, Mühlberg a. E.'
